factoryEvidence.method: IDevice.GetCurrent() manufacturer/product switch plus processor and version branches
factoryEvidence.scope: Review evidence only. The inventory is non-executable and never becomes a runtime device matcher.

matchKinds.PROVEN-PRODUCT: Factory product case creates the class; CPU marketing names are not used to select it.
matchKinds.PROVEN-PRODUCT-CPU: Factory product case plus an explicit processor branch creates the class.
matchKinds.PROVEN-ALIAS: Factory product alias (GEEK / AYA NEO FOUNDER) creates the class.
matchKinds.PARTIAL: At least one variant is proven by the factory; at least one row claim has no factory branch.
matchKinds.CANDIDATE: Same-family factory product exists but the pinned row name is not the factory product string; not a proven binding.
matchKinds.UNKNOWN: No factory product or processor branch proves this row.

runtimePolicy: The existing helper resolves the AMD family from CPUID family+model at runtime; model names and this inventory never select a write route, watt maximum or module. Intel keeps the existing PL1/PL2 MSR path.
unknownPolicy: Rows without factory proof keep no proven deviceId. Candidates and unknowns never become a routing whitelist, watt maximum or model admission.
